speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I haue my Liege. No. Lower. As a man who has been waiting to be spoken to. I haue my Liege.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Again. Not humble. Not brisk. I haue my Liege.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will play him. The four words are his answer. I am only finding the mouth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ould Iohn of Gaunt time honoured Lancaster. That is the King's mouth, not mine. Mine stops at the four. Enough.
